exposure: gestational age at the second-trimester scan
Ultrasound propagation velocity (standard 1540 m/s vs. operator choice of 1420, 1480, or 1540 m/s)
free choice of ultrasound propagation velocity
outcome: Completion rate of fetal ultrasound examination
Anatomical quality of fetal ultrasound images
cohort: 88 obese women undergoing second-trimester ultrasound examination at 20 to 24 gestational weeks
finding: Free choice of ultrasound propagation velocity improved the overall performance of fetal second-trimester ultrasound examinations in obese women, resulting in shorter examination durations and better anatomical image quality.
